sn55.22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.22:1.3: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.22:1.4: idaṃ bhante kapilavatthu iddhañceva phītañca bahujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhaviyūhaṃ.
sn55.22:1.5: so khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāyaṇhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto
sn55.22:1.11: tassa mayhaṃ bhante tasmiṃ samaye mussateva bhagavantaṃ ārabbha sati mussati dhammaṃ ārabbha sati mussati saṅghaṃ ārabbha sati.
sn55.22:1.13: imamhi cāhaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyyaṃ kā mayhaṃ gati ko abhisamparāyoti.
sn55.22:2.1: mā bhāyi mahānāma mā bhāyi mahānāma
sn55.22:2.3: catūhi kho mahānāma dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn55.22:2.5: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.22:2.6: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.22:2.9: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.22:3.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma rukkho pācīnaninno pācīnapoṇo pācīnapabbhāro so mūle chinne katamena papateyyāti.
sn55.22:3.2: yena bhante ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāroti.
sn55.22:3.3: evameva kho mahānāma imehi catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
